Name: Secular / Atheist / Agnostic
Description: Philosophers who are non-religious, atheist, agnostic, or otherwise skeptical of or critical toward religious belief.

Name: Christian (Protestant)
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, the Protestant Christian tradition.

Name: Christian (Catholic)
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, the Roman Catholic Christian tradition.

Name: Jewish
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, Jewish religious tradition and identity.

Name: Deist / Liberal Theist / Eclectic
Description: Philosophers holding an unorthodox, rationalist, or eclectic religious outlook that doesn't fit neatly into a single confessional tradition.

Name: Pagan / Ancient Polytheist
Description: Philosophers working within the polytheistic religious world of pre-Christian Greek and Roman antiquity.

Name: Christian (Other/Generic)
Description: Philosophers identified with Christianity in a general sense, without a specific confessional affiliation given.

Name: Buddhist
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, Buddhist religious tradition.

Name: Confucian / East Asian Traditional
Description: Philosophers working within Confucian ritual and ancestral traditions of East Asia.

Name: Muslim
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, Islamic religious tradition.

Name: Hindu
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, Hindu religious tradition.

Name: Daoist / East Asian Traditional
Description: Philosophers working within Daoist religious and cosmological tradition.

Name: Jain
Description: Philosophers working within, or shaped by, Jain religious tradition.
